ticket: I just signed up and I'm stuck on onboarding. It's not clear what the first step is. I clicked around but nothing tells me what to do first. Can you point me to a setup guide?
Did my payment go through? I entered my card during setup but never got a confirmation. I tried again because I wasn't sure it worked the first time. Please confirm you didn't charge me twice.
Your pricing page is confusing. I can't tell what's included in the trial versus what I'll be charged for. I almost didn't sign up because of this. Please clarify the tiers.

Before I enter my credit card I want to know: is this company legit? There were no trust signals during onboarding so I got nervous. I had to look you up myself. A security/trust page during signup would help.
The identity verification step asked for a lot of personal info with no explanation of why. It made me uncomfortable and I nearly abandoned the setup. Why do you need this?
I was about to cancel during onboarding because I didn't trust entering payment details when the pricing was unclear. Talked myself into staying but it was close.
Spent 20 minutes confused during onboarding, then emailed support. Turns out I missed a step that was not clearly marked. Please make the required steps more obvious.
Why does verification happen twice - once for identity and once for payment? With no confirmation between them I assumed it failed and redid everything. Frustrating.
I contacted support mostly because the onboarding and pricing left me with questions. If those were clearer I wouldn't have needed to reach out at all.
Unclear pricing plus being asked for payment up front made me distrust the product. I searched for reviews before continuing. Lost trust early = almost lost a customer.
